title: GroundBench: A Factorized, Counterfactual Benchmark for Locating VLM Affordance Failures
abstract: arXiv:2609.13308v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A companion evaluation found that naming the target part in a manipulation prompt increased action accuracy by 0.32-0.63 across eight vision-language models, with no model outperforming a constant baseline until the part was named. However, naming the part supplies information that a real system must infer, confounding visual grounding, mechanical reasoning, and category-to-action association. We introduce GroundBench, a diagnostic benchmark that separates these explanations through six branch-and-merge conditions, each adding a controlled information bundle, and a counterfactual re-ask targeting a real alternate part visible in the same image. Across three OpenAI models and 1,068 predictions, supplying the target region without its identity leaves action accuracy at or below the 0.53 majority baseline (0.26, 0.26, and 0.53), although the models largely reproduce the supplied region. translated_title: GroundBench：一个用于定位视觉语言模型可供性失败的分解式、反事实基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.13308v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：一项配套评估发现，在操作提示中命名目标部件使八个视觉语言模型的动作准确率提高了0.32-0.63，且在部件被命名之前，没有任何模型的表现优于恒定基线。然而，命名部件提供了真实系统必须自行推断的信息，这混淆了视觉接地、机械推理和类别到动作的关联。我们提出GroundBench，这是一个诊断基准，通过六个分支-合并条件来分离这些解释，每个条件添加一个受控的信息包，并采用针对同一图像中可见的真实替代部件的反事实重问。在三个OpenAI模型和1,068个预测中，仅提供目标区域而不提供其身份时，动作准确率保持在或低于0.53的多数基线（0.26、0.26和0.53），尽管模型在很大程度上能复现所提供的区域。相反，提供身份而不提供位置则产生0……（摘要截断）
tldr: GroundBench通过六个分支-合并条件与反事实重问的分解式设计，将视觉语言模型可供性失败归因于视觉接地、机械推理和类别-动作关联的混淆因素，并发现仅提供目标区域而不知其身份时，模型动作准确率仍停留在多数基线水平。
en_tdlr: GroundBench is a factorized, counterfactual benchmark that disentangles visual grounding, mechanical reasoning, and category-to-action associations in VLM affordance failures, revealing that supplying the target region without its identity leaves action accuracy at or below the majority baseline.
